nodes.name: NSPC pyrolysis at 800°C
nodes.procedure: 0.1g of chitosan, 0.3g of KOH, and 0.8g of thiourea were thoroughly mixed with a mortar and pestle for at least 60 min to achieve a uniformly fine ground mixture. This mixture was then transferred to an alumina crucible, which was placed in a tube furnace and pyrolyzed at the heating rate of 5°C/min for 120 min at 800°C. High-purity argon gas (99%) at a flow rate of 80 mL/min was passed to maintain an inert atmosphere and ensure even heating and temperature distribution during pyrolysis. The obtained pyrolyzed samples were washed with 1M hydrochloric acid followed by D.I. water multiple times until the pH of the sample reached 7. Finally, the resultant samples were dried at 80°C overnight and named NSPC-800.

nodes.characterization_summary: NSPC-800, NSPC-900, and NSPC-1000 exhibit typical diffraction peaks of carbon materials at (002) and (100) planes, with (002) peak shifting to lower angles (24.27°, 23.92°, 23.85°) as pyrolysis temperature increases from 800°C to 1000°C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of NSPC-800, NSPC-900, and NSPC-1000 are shown in Fig. 1. Each sample exhibited typical diffraction peaks associated with carbon materials corresponding to the (002) and (100) crystal planes.

nodes.characterization_summary: NSPC-800 shows relatively smooth texture and spherical carbon sphere morphology; NSPC-900 and NSPC-1000 show increasing surface roughness with pyrolysis temperature.
nodes.evidence_snippet: SEM analysis revealed in Fig. 2a-c, that the NSPC-800 catalyst possessed a relatively smooth texture and a spherical carbon sphere, whereas NSPC-900 and NSPC-1000 showed increasing surface roughness as pyrolysis temperature increased.

nodes.characterization_summary: NSPC-800 shows spherical texture consistent with SEM observations.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM showed that NSPC-800 has a spherical texture (See Fig. 2i and j), consistent with those observed in SEM.

nodes.characterization_summary: NSPC-800 edges appear frayed indicating significant porosity; absence of continuous C lattice fringes confirms amorphous structure with small graphitic-like stacking.
nodes.evidence_snippet: A high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) exhibited that the edges of the NSPC-800 appeared to be more frayed or ragged, indicating a significant porosity level ... Fig. 2l revealed the absence of continuous and distinct C lattice fringes, suggesting that the NSPC-800 catalyst is amorphous in structure.

nodes.characterization_summary: NSPC-800, NSPC-900, and NSPC-1000 show type IV adsorption isotherm confirming porosity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Supplementary Fig. S1, NS PC-800, NSCP-900 and NSPC-1000 showed type IV adsorption isotherm and confirms the existence of porosity.

nodes.characterization_summary: BET analysis shows NSPC-800 has specific surface area of 609.53 m²/g, pore volume of 0.2731 cm³/g, and average pore size of 2.7601 nm; NSPC-900: 164.78 m²/g, 0.0936 cm³/g, 3.0535 nm; NSPC-1000: 73.35 m²/g, 0.08143 cm³/g, 4.9062 nm (Table 1).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Table 1 BET analysis of NSPC-800, NSPC-900 and NSPC-1000 electrocatalyst. ... NSPC-800: 609.53 m²/g, 0.2731 cm³/g, 2.7601 nm; NSPC-900: 164.78 m²/g, 0.0936 cm³/g, 3.0535 nm; NSPC-1000: 73.35 m²/g, 0.08143 cm³/g, 4.9062 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: NSPC-800 shows G band at 1595 cm⁻¹ and D band at 1312 cm⁻¹ with I_D/I_G ratio of 1.1 indicating higher defect level and amorphous structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Fig. 3a, the G and D bands of the NSPC-800 catalyst that appeared at 1595 cm⁻¹ and 1312 cm⁻¹ ... NSPC-800 has a slightly higher ratio value of 1.1, suggesting a higher level of defects than NSPC-900 and NSPC-1000.

nodes.characterization_summary: NSPC-800 shows O-H at 3427 cm⁻¹, S-C≡N at 2175 cm⁻¹, S=O at 1052 cm⁻¹, S-S at 588 cm⁻¹, C=C at 1595 cm⁻¹, C-N at 1200 cm⁻¹ confirming heteroatom doping.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The broad peak absorbed at 3427 cm⁻¹ was attributed to the stretching vibration of the O-H bond ... the presence of these functional groups, especially O-H, S=O, C-N, and S-S, confirms heteroatoms enriched amorphous porous carbon.

nodes.characterization_summary: NSPC-800 shows C (284.69 eV), N (399.03 eV), S (163.89 eV), O (532.57 eV); C1s: C-C (284.6 eV), C-S (284.8 eV), C-N (285.2 eV), O=C-O (289.3 eV); N1s: pyridinic-N (25.67%), graphitic-N (47.77%); S2p: thiophene-S and oxidized S; N/C=0.16, S/C=0.02.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The survey spectra of all the samples displayed in Fig. 4a exhibited the existence of N, S, C, and O at 399.03 eV, 163.89 eV, 284.69 eV, and 532.57 eV ... the NSPC-800 catalyst exhibited very high graphitic-N of 47.77% and pyridinic-N of 25.67%, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Elemental mapping confirms presence of N, S, and C in NSPC-800 catalyst.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The elemental mapping further confirmed the presence of N, S, and C within all the catalysts as shown in Fig. 2d-h.
